answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. Signed amateur astronomy club membership with observation log stops them at the door: nights logged under one name for years, which means the comet of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. Honest agents barely notice the check, because nights logged under one name for years is something they already have; the pearl falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The signal is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
